component.name: Sotto
component.summary: Voice typing for Linux with whisper.cpp
Голосовой ввод для Linux на whisper.cpp

description.p: Press a key, speak, release it: Sotto transcribes your speech locally with whisper.cpp and pastes the text where the cursor is. Nothing leaves your computer; the only network access is the one-time model download, which is checked against the published SHA-256 sum.

Sotto is a native Qt 6 application that follows your system theme. On Wayland the indicator floats above windows without taking focus, the shortcut comes from the GlobalShortcuts portal and pasting goes through the RemoteDesktop portal, so it needs neither root nor ydotool. GPU acceleration uses Vulkan, and Silero VAD cuts silence before decoding.
